faq.q: How fast can I get an estimate?
faq.a: Send photos through the Concept Preview form and you will have a concept image and an estimate range within 48 hours.

faq.q: Is the Concept Preview exactly what I will get?
faq.a: It is a concept image for planning. We confirm final materials and measurements at your site visit before any work begins.

faq.q: Do you do both framing and finish work?
faq.a: Yes. One team handles rough and finish carpentry, so nothing gets lost between crews.

faq.q: Can you handle more than carpentry?
faq.a: Yes. One Solvern team covers 23 trades, from roofing and windows to a complete remodel.
